concern_4_practical_significance.reviewer_concern: The implementation is much slower per eviction decision than lightweight baselines (75.0/152.1/316.0 ms at capacities 32/64/128 vs ~0.001-0.18 ms) while not outperforming them on miss ratio end-to-end; unclear practical significance.
concern_4_practical_significance.scientific_question: Where does the overhead come from; how much is avoidable implementation cost vs fundamental algorithmic cost; can selective invocation or candidate pruning recover most quality at a fraction of the cost; at what miss-cost regime (if any) would the added cost be justified?
concern_4_practical_significance.response_strategy: Exact-decision-preserving optimized implementation, quality-preserving selective/pruning variants, transparent break-even/miss-cost-sweep/Pareto analysis, non-API only, before evaluating whether an API case study adds anything beyond it.

experiments.name: Exact-optimized variants (cached_exact, vectorized_exact, vectorized_cached_exact)
experiments.note: decision-equivalence proven by test; hoists O(k^2) redundant per-candidate recomputation to O(k), uses pre-existing EvictValueV1Model.predict_loss_batch; smoke-scale run (--max-requests 200) empirically confirms exact decision-equivalence across all 7 traces at cap 32/64 with ~22-30x speedup from batching alone (vectorized_exact/vectorized_cached_exact) and negligible speedup from hoisting alone at these k (~1.0-1.08x, expected to grow with k) -- consistent with model-call-batching being the dominant avoidable cost, not the O(k^2) recomputation, at least at k<=64; cap=128 needs more requests than smoke-scale provides to reach eviction decisions within the trace prefix used

do_not_forget: Do not write the final reviewer response before each concern's experiments are complete.
Do not choose hyperparameters/thresholds/optimization variants based on held-out/test outcomes; use validation data or predeclared fixed values only.
Keep deployment, sensitivity, diagnostic, and primary-fair results in clearly separated artifacts.
Do not use API-backed experiments for Concern 4 unless non-API evidence leaves a specific, named gap.
Negative/null findings must be reported honestly, not hidden or reframed as success.
Re-audit 'current_jobs' fields before citing them in the manuscript; they go stale within minutes.
experiment_dependency_order: 1. Let the C1 (evict_cross_family_resume), C2 (objective_ablation_pipeline), and C3 (distribution_shift_2h_continue) long-running jobs finish their remaining folds.
2. Perform C1/C2/C3 completion audits (leakage/isolation checks, row-count/integrity checks) once each reaches its full expected row count.
3. Run the C4 controlled timing campaign on an idle machine (no C1/C2/C3 jobs active).
4. Run the final frozen statistical analyses for C1/C2/C3 (paired tests, correlations) only once each is complete -- never on partial data.
5. Update the manuscript and reviewer response using the frozen, certified results.
6. Consider an API-backed case study for C4 only if the controlled non-API evidence leaves a specific, named gap.
